_about: Music registry, one entry per track (lane B4 fills it). Files live outside the game in ~/Music/86/ (personal use only, never shipped or shared), so "path" is an absolute path and a missing file is skipped quietly. Entry shape: {"title": "...", "path": "~/Music/86/...", "language": "en" | "ja" | "none", "kind": "opening" | "ending" | "score", "loop": true, "loop_start_s": 0, "loop_end_s": null, "use": ["menu", "combat", "explore"]}.
